messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

- Zyban (discontinued) was used to help stop smoking.
- Auvelity (bupropion with dextromethorphan) is used to treat MDD in adults.
- Contrave (bupropion and naltrexone) is used for weight management for specific patients.

The relation 'has component' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug contains the active or inactive component specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

A. 'has inactive ingredient': The subject drug contains the inactive substance specified by the object entity.
B. 'contains ingredient': The subject drug product contains the active ingredient specified by the object entity.
C. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
